crossRefs.note: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this…
For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you…

translations.web: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’
translations.bsb: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat, so that I may bless you in the presence of the LORD before I die.’
translations.kjv: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.
translations.asv: Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless thee before Jehovah before my death.
